title: China's Top AI Models Trained on Banned Nvidia Chips
excerpt: Recent research reveals that China's most powerful artificial intelligence models were trained using Nvidia chips subject to export bans.
body_html: Recent research indicates that China's most advanced artificial intelligence models rely on Nvidia chips that are subject to export restrictions. The findings show that despite international trade controls intended to limit access to high-end processing hardware, restricted technology has been utilized behind the development of these powerful AI systems.
